newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares close 1.33 pct lower as blue-chips skid.
newsitem.headline: KL shares close 1.33 pct lower as blue-chips skid.

text.p: Blue chips finished 1.33 percent weaker as profit taking kept the market mostly in the negative through the day, traders said.
The Composite Index of 100 large-capitalised stocks fell 16.34 points to 1,212.55, led by a 6.45 percent fall of power firm Tenaga.
Institutions were trimming their positions ahead of the festival holidays which will start next week, when the exchange will close for four market days.
"The blue-chip selling seems to be foreign-led like yesterday," said a salesman at a local house.
